summary: Built the Hunter.io cold email pipeline end-to-end with HITL confirmation.
highlights: Built cold-email-outreach cron using Hunter.io API: reads tracker.md, discovers verified emails, drafts tailored cold emails, delivers via Telegram
Implemented HITL request-file pattern to confirm company/domain/role before spending API credits
Fixed bug where script ignored the company argument and auto-picked the wrong lead
Dropped xurl — confirmed OAuth2 PKCE flow broken on headless Linux and X API free tier has no search anyway
